text:
ECA::username
Description
The ECA::username command returns NTLM authenticating username.
Syntax
ECA
::
username
Examples
when
ECA_REQUEST_ALLOWED
{
log
local0.
"User [ECA::username]@[ECA::domainname], Client Machine [ECA::client_machine_name], Auth Status [ECA::status]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ECA_REQUEST_ALLOWED
ECA_REQUEST_DENIED
